text: I live in the city of London, in Fleet Street, and I have a history. I was built by William the First, in the year 1689, and I was lighted by a single lamp. In 1692, I saw the great fire that consumed ninety houses, and I was myself partially burned. In 1694, I was rebuilt, and saw the streets made straight. name: First a thought, afterwards a date
text: I live in the present. I am a living, active, and voluntary motion, and have no other existence. I am not a past, nor a future, but a present time. I am not a date, but a date. I am not a period, but a period. I am not a time, but a date. I am not an age, but an age.

I dwell, therefore, in the coat added by the time of William the Conqueror, which was the third coat, and the innermost but one, from the time of the Romans.
